overview.purpose: High-throughput, low-latency, distributed messaging and streaming platform in Java engineered for financial-grade transactional messaging, strict FIFO ordered queues, massive million-topic queue capacity, sub-millisecond sequential append-only persistence via memory-mapped files and off-heap direct byte buffer pools, and term-based high-availability quorum replication with DLedger Raft controller failover.
overview.architectureType: Decoupled Distributed Multi-Tier Broker architecture with stateless NameServer route coordination, unified physical CommitLog append-only storage with concurrent logical ConsumeQueue dispatching, two-tier off-heap TransientStorePool memory pinning (mlock), synchronous/asynchronous disk flush pipelines, epoch-scoped SyncStateSet replication (AutoSwitchHAService / DLedger Controller), and server-side Pop/Push consumption state machines.
keyDifferentiators: Single CommitLog Sequential Append: Writes all messages across all topics and queues sequentially into 1GB memory-mapped files under a spin-lock or reentrant lock, achieving near-hardware-speed sequential disk I/O throughput while offloading consumption queue creation to an asynchronous reput pipeline.

Dual-Buffer TransientStorePool with Direct Memory Pinning: Utilizes pooled direct ByteBuffers pinned into physical RAM via JNA LibC mlock, completely decoupling client write buffer appends from OS PageCache dirty page flushes to avoid OS kernel write stalls.

Fixed 20-Byte ConsumeQueue & IndexFile Units: Encodes logical queue indices (CommitLog Offset [8B], Size [4B], Tag HashCode [8B]) and key hash indices (Key Hash [4B], Physical Offset [8B], Time Diff [4B], Prev Slot [4B]) into fixed-size units enabling constant-time binary search and zero-heap index traversal.

Stateless NameServer Registry with Self-Healing Route Discovery: Eliminates heavy consensus protocols (ZooKeeper/etcd) in favor of peerless, eventually consistent NameServer nodes refreshed via 30-second broker heartbeat pings and 120-second channel eviction scans.

Stateless 5.0 Pop Consumption & PopReviveService: Decouples consumer instance scaling from queue count partitions through short invisible leases, lightweight checkpoint records in CHECK_POINT_TOPIC, and automatic retry requeuing via PopReviveService.

Two-Phase Commit (2PC) Transactional Engine: Executes distributed financial transactions through invisible Half-Topic staging (RMQ_SYS_TRANS_HALF_TOPIC), Op-Topic commit tracking (RMQ_SYS_TRANS_OP_HALF_TOPIC), and active broker transaction status check queries.

invariants.atomicStatement: CommitLog appends all topic messages sequentially under a mutual exclusion lock (PutMessageSpinLock or PutMessageReentrantLock), guaranteeing strictly monotonic physical offsets across concurrent producer threads.
invariants.enforcingMechanism: CommitLog.asyncPutMessage acquires putMessageLock before mapping message byte buffers to mappedFile.appendMessage, updating beginTimeInLock for fast-failure telemetry.

testEvidence.observation: Appends concurrent IPv4 and IPv6 messages to DefaultMessageStore, verifying that sequential physical offsets are monotonically assigned and all 20 messages are retrievable without data corruption.

historicalContext.context: Refined CommitLog lock documentation and buffer comments to clarify lock-guarded append boundaries.

invariants.atomicStatement: ConsumeQueue units are strictly fixed at 20 bytes (8B CommitLog Offset + 4B Message Size + 8B Tag HashCode), guaranteeing O(1) random offset calculation via logicOffset = cqOffset * 20.
invariants.enforcingMechanism: ConsumeQueue.putMessagePositionInfo formats byteBufferIndex with 8-byte offset, 4-byte size, and 8-byte tag hashcode, writing exactly 20 bytes per logical unit to mapped file.

testEvidence.observation: Asserts that writing 100 consecutive DispatchRequests produces exact 2000-byte mapped file slices and verify correct deserialization of physical offsets and tag hashes.

historicalContext.context: Enforced strict startIndex >= getMinOffsetInQueue() boundary checks across RocksDBConsumeQueue to align with 20-byte file-based logic queue indexing.

invariants.atomicStatement: IndexFile stores 20-byte index items (4B Key Hash + 8B PhyOffset + 4B TimeDiff + 4B PrevIndexPos) and chains hash collisions through 5,000,000 fixed 4-byte slots to allow constant-time message querying by user key.
invariants.enforcingMechanism: IndexFile.putKey reads slot value at absSlotPos = 40 + slotPos * 4, stores old slot value into index entry prevIndexPos, and overwrites slot with current index count.

testEvidence.observation: Inserts keys with identical hash slots and verifies reverse-chronological collision chain traversal retrieves all matching physical offsets.

historicalContext.context: Maintained IndexFile fixed 420MB mapped file binary format across RocketMQ 5.5.1 release line.

invariants.atomicStatement: TransientStorePool pre-allocates DirectByteBuffers and locks them in physical RAM via LibC mlock, preventing OS dirty page flush pauses from blocking CommitLog appends.
invariants.enforcingMechanism: TransientStorePool.init allocates ByteBuffer.allocateDirect(fileSize), extracts native memory address via Netty PlatformDependent, and calls LibC.INSTANCE.mlock(pointer, fileSize).

testEvidence.observation: Measures write throughput under TransientStorePool, confirming zero page cache lock contention compared to direct mmap writing.

historicalContext.context: Eliminated transitive fastjson1 memory leaks to safeguard long-running direct buffer pools.

failureModesAndDefenses.failureMode: OS PageCache Write Stall / Disk I/O Saturation Hanging Producer Requests
failureModesAndDefenses.detectionMechanism: CommitLog.isOSPageCacheBusy detects lock duration > osPageCacheBusyTimeOutMills (1000ms) by measuring elapsed time since beginTimeInLock.
failureModesAndDefenses.recoveryAction: BrokerFastFailure background thread aggressively purges pending messages in sendThreadPoolQueue, immediately returning SYSTEM_BUSY to client SDKs to trigger fast failover to alternative broker instances.

sourceEvidence.observation: BrokerFastFailure cleans send queue and emits PCBUSY_CLEAN_QUEUE responses during disk stalls.

historicalOccurrence.rootCause: Netty pipeline threads blocked indefinitely when request processors lacked uniform rejection hooks.
historicalOccurrence.fixDescription: Implemented default rejectRequest handler in NettyRequestProcessor.

failureModesAndDefenses.prescribedMitigation: Enable TransientStorePool and configure warmMappedFileEnable=true to lock physical memory and prevent OS page write stalls.

failureModesAndDefenses.failureMode: Master Broker Hardware Crash / Sudden Power Loss
failureModesAndDefenses.detectionMechanism: DLedger Controller detects missed heartbeat from active master via RaftReplicasInfoManager.checkNotActiveBroker.
failureModesAndDefenses.recoveryAction: DLedger Controller elects new master from SyncStateSet quorum. The promoted slave invokes AutoSwitchHAService.changeToMaster(newEpoch), truncates uncommitted dirty logs above epoch boundary, advances confirmOffset, appends epoch entry, and resumes client writes.

sourceEvidence.observation: Coordinates dirty log truncation and epoch cache advancement during master promotion.

historicalOccurrence.rootCause: Raft controller failed to scan inactive master sets when heartbeat timed out, delaying auto-recovery.
historicalOccurrence.fixDescription: Added scanNeedReelectBrokerSets to actively detect expired raft masters.

failureModesAndDefenses.prescribedMitigation: Deploy 3-node controller clusters with allAckInSyncStateSet=true to guarantee zero message loss during ungraceful master crashes.

failureModesAndDefenses.failureMode: Consumer Node Crash During Pop Message Processing
failureModesAndDefenses.detectionMechanism: PopReviveService tails REVIVE_TOPIC and detects PopCheckPoint records whose invisibleTime has expired without matching ACK.
failureModesAndDefenses.recoveryAction: PopReviveService reformulates the unacknowledged payload into a retry message, increments reconsumeTimes, and appends it to %RETRY%<Group> topic for redelivery to surviving consumer instances.

sourceEvidence.observation: PopReviveService recreates retry message and decrements inflight message counter.

historicalOccurrence.rootCause: Concurrent pop orderly retries with same attemptId failed lock acquisition and returned empty responses.
historicalOccurrence.fixDescription: Implemented spin-locking on same attemptId pop retry.

failureModesAndDefenses.prescribedMitigation: Set appropriate invisibleTime matching maximum consumer processing duration to prevent false redeliveries.

failureModesAndDefenses.failureMode: Transactional Producer Crash Before Sending 2PC Commit/Rollback
failureModesAndDefenses.detectionMechanism: TransactionalMessageCheckService detects prepared half-messages in RMQ_SYS_TRANS_HALF_TOPIC older than transactionTimeOut with no corresponding Op-topic record.
failureModesAndDefenses.recoveryAction: Broker initiates CHECK_TRANSACTION_STATE RPC back to surviving producer cluster members to query local transaction status, committing or rolling back based on producer response.

sourceEvidence.observation: Check service cross-references half topic against op topic and sends verification queries.

historicalOccurrence.rootCause: Legacy DLedger broker mode caused deadlock during transaction check listener startup.
historicalOccurrence.fixDescription: Decoupled transaction checking from embedded DLedger consensus.

failureModesAndDefenses.prescribedMitigation: Implement idempotent local transaction check listeners in producer applications.

failureModesAndDefenses.failureMode: TransientStorePool Direct Buffer Starvation Under High Write Bursts
failureModesAndDefenses.detectionMechanism: TransientStorePool.borrowBuffer() detects availableBuffers.size() < poolSize * 0.4 and emits warning logs.
failureModesAndDefenses.recoveryAction: DefaultMappedFile falls back to direct MappedByteBuffer writes when TransientStorePool buffer is unavailable, and CommitRealTimeService accelerates writeBuffer commit cycles to return buffers to the pool.

sourceEvidence.observation: Returns writeBuffer to pool as soon as committedPosition reaches fileSize.

historicalOccurrence.rootCause: Excessive temporary allocations during LMQ append exhausted direct buffer pool memory.
historicalOccurrence.fixDescription: Optimized memory allocations in LMQ append path.

failureModesAndDefenses.prescribedMitigation: Size transientStorePoolSize to accommodate peak burst durations (default 5 sheets = 5GB off-heap memory).

failureModesAndDefenses.failureMode: NameServer Network Partition / Broker Heartbeat Channel Drop
failureModesAndDefenses.recoveryAction: NameServer closes broker netty channel and invokes onChannelDestroy to purge broker address from topicQueueTable, brokerAddrTable, and clusterAddrTable. Producer SDKs refresh routes within 30s.

sourceEvidence.observation: Evicts dead broker addresses from in-memory routing tables.

historicalOccurrence.rootCause: BrokerIdentityInfo equals/hashCode mismatch caused duplicate registrations in controller live tables.
historicalOccurrence.fixDescription: Safely compared partial broker identities in heartbeat table.

failureModesAndDefenses.prescribedMitigation: Configure producer retryAnotherBrokerWhenNotStoreOK=true to automatically reroute traffic during NameServer route convergence.

historicalEvolution.rootCause: startIndex < minOffset was accepted as long as it stayed within [0, maxOffset), returning a non-null LargeRocksDBConsumeQueueIterator whose next() yielded null CqUnit after data purge, triggering NPEs in ScheduleMessageService.
historicalEvolution.architecturalFix: Added strict startIndex >= getMinOffsetInQueue() validation to both iterateFrom overloads, returning null to enable callers to detect and correct out-of-range offsets.

historicalEvolution.rootCause: DLedger Controller failed to scan inactive master sets when heartbeat timed out, delaying auto-recovery of crashed raft masters.
historicalEvolution.architecturalFix: Implemented scanNeedReelectBrokerSets in checkNotActiveBroker to actively detect expired raft masters and trigger controller re-election.

evidence.observation: Lines 126-140 cross-reference live table heartbeats against active master sets to schedule elections.

historicalEvolution.milestoneOrBug: Async Request-Reply RequestCallback Duplicate Invocation Race Condition
historicalEvolution.rootCause: DefaultMQProducerImpl.request async onSuccess delivered premature onSuccess(null) on send success before reply arrival, and race between reply and timeout caused duplicate callback execution.
historicalEvolution.architecturalFix: Added AtomicBoolean executeCallbackOnlyOnce guard in RequestResponseFuture and atomic ConcurrentHashMap.remove in RequestFutureHolder to ensure single-shot execution.

evidence.observation: Guards callback invocation with executeCallbackOnlyOnce.compareAndSet(false, true).

historicalEvolution.milestoneOrBug: Data Race in ServiceThread Wakeup Mechanism
historicalEvolution.rootCause: ServiceThread.waitForRunning and wakeup used non-atomic boolean flags, leading to lost wakeup notifications and delayed background flushing.
historicalEvolution.architecturalFix: Replaced wait/notify with LockSupport.parkNanos/unpark and AtomicBoolean hasNotified CAS transitions with memory barrier publication.

evidence.observation: Lines 105-143 use hasNotified.compareAndSet with LockSupport.unpark and parkNanos.

historicalEvolution.milestoneOrBug: Lite Topic Reset Offset Memory Leak and FIFO Block Bypass
historicalEvolution.rootCause: removeResetOffset left empty inner map entries in resetOffsetTable causing memory leak, isFifoBlocked erroneously blocked consumer during admin reset offset, and resetOffset > 0 prevented resetting to offset 0.
historicalEvolution.architecturalFix: Cleaned up empty inner maps, added eraseResetOffset, bypassed FIFO check when server-side reset is pending, and relaxed reset bounds to resetOffset >= 0.

evidence.observation: Removes empty maps and supports offset 0 in admin reset commands.

unresolvedContradictionsAndBypasses.claimOrGuarantee: GroupCommitService guarantees synchronous durability on disk before completing producer PutMessageResult future.
unresolvedContradictionsAndBypasses.contradictionOrBypass: When transientStorePoolEnable=true, GroupCommitService loops up to 1000 times sleeping 1ms waiting for CommitRealTimeService to transfer writeBuffer data into FileChannel pageCache before mappedFileQueue.flush(0) can succeed. If commit thread is stalled, GroupCommitService spins and sleeps in 1ms increments, introducing multi-millisecond tail latency.
unresolvedContradictionsAndBypasses.evidence: Code comment explicitly states: 'When transientStorePoolEnable is true, the messages in writeBuffer may not be committed to pageCache very quickly, and flushOk here may almost be false, so we can sleep 1ms to wait for the messages to be committed to pageCache.'

unresolvedContradictionsAndBypasses.claimOrGuarantee: Messages are instantly consumable as soon as producer receives PUT_OK status.
unresolvedContradictionsAndBypasses.contradictionOrBypass: CommitLog.asyncPutMessage returns PUT_OK once physical log is written, but ConsumeQueue is updated asynchronously by ReputMessageService. Under high ingestion load, reputFromOffset lags behind commitLog.getMaxOffset(), causing immediate consumer pull requests to return NOT_FOUND until dispatch catches up.
unresolvedContradictionsAndBypasses.evidence: ReputMessageService runs in a separate ServiceThread; dispatch behind bytes is observable via defaultMessageStore.dispatchBehindBytes().

unresolvedContradictionsAndBypasses.claimOrGuarantee: RebalanceLockManager guarantees strict single-consumer mutual exclusion on ordered message queues.
unresolvedContradictionsAndBypasses.contradictionOrBypass: If a consumer JVM experiences a GC pause or network stall exceeding REBALANCE_LOCK_MAX_LIVE_TIME (60,000ms), RebalanceLockManager marks the lock expired and reassigns it to another consumer. When the stalled consumer resumes, it executes without fencing tokens, causing concurrent out-of-order consumption on un-fenced storage.
unresolvedContradictionsAndBypasses.evidence: if (lockEntry.isExpired()) { lockEntry.setClientId(clientId); return true; } does not revoke execution privileges of already-in-flight worker threads.

unresolvedContradictionsAndBypasses.claimOrGuarantee: NameServer provides authoritative, synchronized cluster route metadata.
unresolvedContradictionsAndBypasses.contradictionOrBypass: NameServer nodes are completely independent and share no consensus state. Heartbeats arrive at different times across NameServers, causing temporary routing discrepancies where producers route traffic to a broker that another NameServer has already marked dead.
unresolvedContradictionsAndBypasses.evidence: scanNotActiveBroker runs locally per NameServer instance on an independent 10-second timer with 120-second timeout.

boundaryConditions: CommitLog mapped file roll-over under high concurrency can trigger brief allocation spikes if AllocateMappedFileService pre-allocation queue is depleted.
JVM Full GC pauses exceeding 1000ms trigger BrokerFastFailure to purge incoming client send requests, generating transient burst errors to clients.
Controller failover during SyncStateSet shrink requires surviving nodes to form quorum; network partitions isolating controller quorum block all master promotions.
untestedAssumptions: Assumes underlying file system handles 1GB file pre-allocation (mlock / posix_fallocate) without triggering operating system kernel panic or blocking other processes.
Assumes producer clock and broker clock skew is negligible when computing transaction timeout immunity windows.
Assumes client SDKs implement exponential backoff and idempotency on receipt of SYSTEM_BUSY or NOT_ENOUGH_REPLICAS status codes.
acceptedTradeOffs: Accepted at-least-once delivery with duplicate redelivery across broker failovers in exchange for avoiding distributed two-phase commit overhead on standard message paths.
Accepted eventual consistency across NameServer nodes in exchange for eliminating ZooKeeper/etcd cluster dependencies and achieving ultra-lightweight operational footprint.
Accepted async ConsumeQueue dispatch lag behind physical CommitLog appends in exchange for maximum sequential write throughput.
